Protocol Rebirth — Abandoned Town Starter Kit v0.1

8 individual low-poly GLB assets. 1 unit = 1 meter; Y is up; each origin is centered on the footprint at ground level. Color is stored in shared named PBR materials; no external textures required.

Import assets/env/town/*.glb. Use manifest.json for approximate bounds, category and placement hints. Collision is intentionally not baked in; create simple box/capsule colliders from dimensions and placement notes in the game engine.
